description: Source code for a Git credential helper using libsecret to store and retrieve credentials from GNOME Keyring, including functions for get, store, and erase operations, credential parsing, and main control flow.

methods.name: make_label
methods.description: Creates a label string for a credential based on protocol, host, port, and path.

methods.name: make_attr_list
methods.description: Constructs a hash table of attributes from a credential for searching/storing in libsecret.

methods.name: keyring_get
methods.description: Retrieves a credential from the GNOME Keyring using libsecret.

methods.name: keyring_store
methods.description: Stores a credential into the GNOME Keyring using libsecret.

methods.name: keyring_erase
methods.description: Erases a credential from the GNOME Keyring using libsecret.

methods.name: credential_init
methods.description: Initializes a credential struct to default values.

methods.name: credential_clear
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for credential fields and reinitializes the struct.

methods.name: credential_read
methods.description: Reads credential data from stdin, parsing key-value pairs.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the credential helper.
